scope: One bounded status/run inventory and adaptive terminal log/source reads for APP PR1192 a07 and D PR8 c930 only. No frozen PR/run was queried, no poll loop, source adoption, test/runtime, artifact binary download, ref/PR/CI mutation, rerun/cancel/dispatch or external communication was performed.
captureSemantics: API bodies are complete tool-returned JSON text, not asserted to be wire-byte HTTP captures. Logs are complete decoded tool-returned job-log text with original CRLF/ANSI retained. Separate API reads are not atomic. The APP run-list remains queued while its check/job snapshots already contain terminal children; all captured observations are preserved without replacing the earlier snapshot. Exact fetch wall-clock values were not separately recorded for every call.

syntheticMerges.checkoutLimit: The General display_title binds this merge and action=synchronize/draft=true, but its plan job is queued. The six fetched APP execution logs explicitly check out a07; no executed synthetic-merge job is inferred.
Safe Node and sampled native logs check out c930 directly. Same-tree synthetic merge identity is not substituted for actual checkout.

inventory.pagination: All run/check/job first pages have retained length equal to total_count; all <=100. No omitted later page is assumed.

Why
The existing frontend offers browser and device-code Codex login. The extracted app-server client currently exposes account reads/refresh/logout but cannot drive those login workflows through Host custody.

## Changes
Add finite typed account/login/start, account/login/cancel and private completion observation. Preserve native login IDs, unknown acceptance and no replay. The consumer keeps browser presentation, early-ID correlation, process custody, credential ownership and account readback. Session SPI and conversation event delivery remain compatible.

## Validation
Node 24.21.0 / pnpm 11.18.0: pnpm check passed (build, typecheck, 509 source tests and both packed consumers). The subprocess protocol suite covers 7 login cases. Node 26.11.1 / pnpm 11.18.0 also passed the complete check (509 source tests and both packed consumers). The retained packed-consumer artifact has SHA-256 `691a7a62cdd5a92e2edb120f2c409790c9ca16215495cdf9daa099b3b8748bd9`; the Session SPI archive is byte-identical to the frontend's current pin. This is protocol evidence, not vendor authentication or Desktop UI acceptance.

Frontend integration: https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/pull/1186
Plan: docs/plans/provider-migration/frontend-parity-2026-11-12/01-codex-login.md in that repository.

name: Host Emulated Acceptance

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/host-emulated-acceptance.yml'
      - 'packages/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'packages/task-change-ledger/**'
      - 'scripts/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'tools/owned-process-broker/fixtures/**'
      - 'tools/linux-node-exec/**'
      - 'scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs'
      - 'scripts/dev-with-runtime.mjs'
      - 'scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/afterPack.cjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/dist.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/verifyLinuxNodeExec.cjs'
      - 'src/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'src/features/runtime-provider-management/**'
      - 'src/features/codex-runtime-installer/**'
      - 'src/features/opencode-runtime-installer/**'
      - 'src/main/**'
      - 'src/preload/**'
      - 'src/renderer/**'
      - 'src/shared/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'

permissions:
  contents: read

# Draft PRs run finite peers and the separately declared OpenCode-only local-model lane.
# Existing native Claude/Codex gates keep their scope.
concurrency:
  # Leave the obsolete always-aggregate group after all of its matrix jobs were cancelled.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-v2-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  offline-desktop-scenario:
    name: Offline Host Desktop (${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}, ${{ matrix.lane }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [team, taskboard, skills, cross-team, collaboration, extensions, import, management, codex-login, codex, claude, claude-lifecycle, opencode, review, selection, processes]
        include:
          - lane: installer
            runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
          - lane: opencode-v2-management
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux-x64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_EMULATED_LANE: ${{ matrix.lane }}
      HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Verify original checkout and runner tuple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(process.platform + '-' + process.arch, process.env.HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM)"
          printf 'TMPDIR=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Prepare private Linux display
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y xvfb xauth lsof
      - name: Install frozen workspace and Electron
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(require('electron/package.json').version, '44.10.1')"
          pnpm exec electron-rebuild --module-dir . --force --only better-sqlite3 --version 44.10.1
      - name: Build existing Desktop prerequisites and verify admission
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" = Linux ]]; then node scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs; fi
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-controller build
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          node --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-backend-observations.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-team-ui-smoke.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/test-child-process-trace.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-emulated-settings.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-emulated-codex-catalog.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-resume-records.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-captured-app-exit.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-opencode-v2-management-records.test.ts
          node --test test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs
      - name: Verify original Runtime and Team conversation contracts
        if: matrix.lane == 'team'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-activity.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-team-host.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/team-snapshot.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/team-product-changes.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/team-activity-read.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/captured-claude-process.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/codex-member-provider.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/member-process-stderr.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/member-provider-authority.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/owned-process-facade.test.ts
          node --test scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/platform.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/packaged.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/catalog.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/stage-candidate.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/v2-support-repair.test.mjs
      - name: Verify complete workspace types and original typed lint scopes
        if: matrix.lane == 'team'

          set -euo pipefail

  offline-frontend-tests:
    name: Offline frontend tests (${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_TEST_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Verify source and capture the original Host test runtime
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          echo "AGENT_BACKEND_TEST_NODE=$(node -p 'process.execPath')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Setup the original workspace test runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare original test prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lsof
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ci/rebuild-better-sqlite3-node.cjs
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Run the complete safe frontend shard
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Live subscriptions and real vendor executables are outside this finite lane.
          # Excluded files remain unqualified; the existing native gates are unchanged.
          pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard="$HOST_TEST_SHARD/4" \
            --exclude '**/*.live.test.*' --exclude '**/*.live-e2e.test.*' --exclude '**/*.native.test.*' \
            --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.json" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.log"
      - name: Preserve original test results, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: host-offline-tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.log

  offline-desktop:
    name: Offline Host Desktop
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) }}
    needs: [offline-desktop-scenario, offline-frontend-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require every original UI lane and safe frontend shard to pass
        env:
          HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-desktop-scenario'].result }}
          HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-frontend-tests'].result }}
        run: |
          test "$HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT" = success
          test "$HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT" = success

name: Host process fixture acceptance

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/host-process-acceptance.yml'
      - 'agent-teams-controller/**'
      - 'packages/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'packages/task-change-ledger/**'
      - 'src/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'src/main/utils/ownedProcess/**'

      - 'src/main/utils/electronNodeLaunch.ts'
      - 'src/main/utils/linuxNodeExecArtifact.ts'

      - 'test/main/build/electronBuilderAfterPack.test.ts'
      - 'test/features/agent-backend/**'

# Draft-safe process fixtures have their own evidence; existing native-provider gates remain intact.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  process-fixtures:
    name: Host process fixtures (${{ matrix.platform }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
            arch: arm64
          - runner: macos-15-intel
            platform: darwin-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-2022
            platform: win32-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-11-arm
            platform: win32-arm64
            arch: arm64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Enable Windows long paths
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      # Use the exact Corepack bundled with the selected Node; avoid a second
      # package-manager bootstrap and native-engine self-switch on macOS Intel.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Select the pinned package manager with bundled Corepack
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(corepack --version)" = 0.36.0
          corepack enable
          corepack install --global pnpm@11.22.0
          test "$(pnpm --version)" = 11.22.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Bind exact source and actual process tuple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD"
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; assert.equal(process.version,'v24.21.0'); assert.equal(process.platform+'-'+process.arch,process.env.HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM)"
          mkdir process-acceptance-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD > process-acceptance-evidence/source-head.txt
      - name: Install frozen workspace without Desktop postinstall
        run: node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build existing controller and Host
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p packages/task-change-ledger/tsconfig.json
          node agent-teams-controller/scripts/build.mjs
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p packages/legacy-agent-host/tsconfig.json
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p packages/legacy-agent-host/tsconfig.test.json
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.json
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.retained-host.json
      - name: Verify process contracts and retained Main Host transport
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/claude-management-host.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/scheduled-run-host.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/management-command-store.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/owned-process-facade.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-job-custody.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-owner.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-capture-records.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-commands.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-linux-warm-lifetime.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-build-selection.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/lifecycle-process-release.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-provider-routing.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-launcher-recipe.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-finite-process-routing.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-source-process-selections.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-source-probe-origins.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/management-model-probe.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/saved-team-model-probe.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/host-contracts.log
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 --config tools/owned-process-broker/vitest.config.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/protocol.log
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 test/features/agent-backend/capturedHostClient.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedWindowsSelection.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/desktopBackendFeature.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/fileTeamModelProbeIntents.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedRuntimeSourceNativeAdmission.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedWindowsSourceHistory.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedWindowsSourcePending.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/hostOpenCodeV2ModelProbeLifecycle.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/retained-main.log
      - name: Verify original POSIX Node and shell lifecycle fixtures
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/captured-claude-process.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-source-native-identity.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/posix-lifecycle.log
      - name: Prepare pinned Electron for native process fixtures
        if: runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {createRequire} from 'node:module'; assert.equal(createRequire(import.meta.url)('electron/package.json').version,'44.10.1')"
      - name: Verify Linux Node exec descriptor closure under both original parents
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HOST_NODE_EXEC_TARGET="$(command -v node)" node --test scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node-exec-node24.log
          HOST_NODE_EXEC_TARGET="$(command -v node)" ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 node_modules/electron/dist/electron --test scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node-exec-electron.log
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 test/main/build/electronBuilderAfterPack.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node-exec-packaging.log
      - name: Qualify original Linux pidfs and retained pidfd under Host Node
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          LEGACY_REGISTERED_PROCESS_NATIVE_GO: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers=$(node -p "require('path').resolve(require('path').dirname(process.execPath),'../include/node')")
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" "$headers" 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node24.log
          cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node24
      - name: Qualify original Linux pidfs and retained pidfd under Electron Node
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          LEGACY_REGISTERED_PROCESS_NATIVE_GO: '1'
          ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers=$(node -p "require('path').resolve(require('path').dirname(process.execPath),'../include/node')")
          node_modules/electron/dist/electron packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-electron-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" "$headers" 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-electron.log
          cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-electron-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" process-acceptance-evidence/linux-electron
      - name: Build original Windows product broker and C++ fixtures
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $build = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-process-build-${{ matrix.arch }}'
          $stage = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-process-stage-${{ matrix.arch }}'
          $scoped = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-process-scoped-stage-${{ matrix.arch }}'
          $cmake = (Get-Command cmake.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts '${{ matrix.arch }}' $build $stage $cmake
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native fixture build or product staging failed' }
          $staged = @(Get-ChildItem -File $stage | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
          if ((($staged | Sort-Object) -join ',') -ne 'manifest.json,owned-process-broker.exe') { throw 'Unexpected staged fixture' }
          "HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD=$build" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE=$stage" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          Copy-Item "$stage\manifest.json" process-acceptance-evidence/windows-manifest.json
          node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts '${{ matrix.arch }}' $build $scoped $cmake service-scopes-v1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Scoped native fixture build or product staging failed' }
          $scopedFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -File $scoped | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
          if ((($scopedFiles | Sort-Object) -join ',') -ne 'manifest.json,owned-process-broker.exe') { throw 'Unexpected scoped stage fixture' }
          "HOST_PROCESS_SCOPED_STAGE=$scoped" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          Copy-Item "$scoped\manifest.json" process-acceptance-evidence/windows-scoped-manifest.json
          $i386Build = "$build-i386"
          $i386Target = Join-Path $build 'Release\owned-process-fixture-i386.exe'
          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $i386Target) { throw 'I386 TEST target must be fresh' }
          $compileI386 = @'
          import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
          const [cmake, source, build] = process.argv.slice(1);
          for (const args of [['-S', source, '-B', build, '-A', 'Win32'],
            ['--build', build, '--config', 'Release', '--target', 'owned-process-fixture']]) {
            const result = spawnSync(cmake, args, { stdio: 'inherit', timeout: 120000 });
            if (result.error || result.status !== 0) throw new Error('Same-source TEST Win32 fixture build failed');
          }
          '@
          node --input-type=module -e $compileI386 $cmake (Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker') $i386Build
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Same-source TEST Win32 fixture build failed' }
          $i386Built = Join-Path $i386Build 'Release\owned-process-fixture.exe'
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath $i386Built -Destination $i386Target -ErrorAction Stop
          if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $i386Built -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -cne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $i386Target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) {
            throw 'I386 TEST fixture copy changed bytes'
          }
          "HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_I386_FIXTURE=$i386Target" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          Get-ChildItem -File "$build\Release\*.exe" | Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 | Format-List | Out-File process-acceptance-evidence/windows-binary-sha256.txt
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path native-evidence | Out-Null
          Copy-Item process-acceptance-evidence/windows-binary-sha256.txt native-evidence/binary-sha256.txt
      - name: Qualify original Windows Job and control under Host Node
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if (-not $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_I386_FIXTURE) { throw 'Original Windows fixture gate requires its built I386 TEST target' }
          $build = $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD
          $controller = "$build\Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe"
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $runner = Join-Path $PWD 'node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs'
          $gate = Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeGate.ts'
          & $controller $node $runner $gate "$env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-fixture.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-birth-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-accounting-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-release-delay.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-debug-service.exe" 2>&1 | Tee-Object process-acceptance-evidence/windows-node24.log
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original Node fixture controller did not confirm cleanup' }
      - name: Qualify original Windows Job and control under Electron Node
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1'
        run: |
          if (-not $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_I386_FIXTURE) { throw 'Original Electron fixture gate requires its built I386 TEST target' }
          $build = $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD
          $controller = "$build\Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe"
          $electron = Join-Path $PWD 'node_modules\electron\dist\electron.exe'
          $runner = Join-Path $PWD 'node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs'
          $gate = Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeGate.ts'
          & $controller $electron $runner $gate "$env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-fixture.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-birth-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-accounting-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-release-delay.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-debug-service.exe" 2>&1 | Tee-Object process-acceptance-evidence/windows-electron.log
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original Electron fixture controller did not confirm cleanup' }
      - name: Qualify Windows wrappers and actual Main Host provider routes with TEST peers
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $build = $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD
          $controller = "$build\Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe"
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $runner = Join-Path $PWD 'node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs'
          $tsconfig = Join-Path $PWD 'tsconfig.json'
          $gate = Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeEmulatedProviderGate.ts'
          $receipt = Join-Path $PWD 'process-acceptance-evidence\windows-emulated-provider-receipt.json'
          & $controller $node $runner --tsconfig $tsconfig $gate "$env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-fixture.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-birth-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-accounting-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-release-delay.exe" "$env:HOST_PROCESS_SCOPED_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" $receipt 2>&1 | Tee-Object process-acceptance-evidence/windows-emulated-provider.log
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original emulated-provider controller did not confirm cleanup' }
      - name: Qualify original codex source A B with TEST peer
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $build = $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD
          $controller = "$build\Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe"
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $runner = Join-Path $PWD 'node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs'
          $tsconfig = Join-Path $PWD 'tsconfig.json'
          $gate = Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeEmulatedProviderGate.ts'
          $receipt = Join-Path $PWD 'process-acceptance-evidence\windows-source-codex-receipt.json'
          & $controller $node $runner --tsconfig $tsconfig $gate "$env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-fixture.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-birth-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-accounting-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-release-delay.exe" "$env:HOST_PROCESS_SCOPED_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" $receipt --test-source-provider codex 2>&1 | Tee-Object process-acceptance-evidence/windows-source-codex.log
          $controllerExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
          [ordered]@{ kind = 'TEST_SOURCE_CONTROLLER_EXIT'; provider = 'codex'; exitCode = [int]$controllerExitCode } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
          if ($controllerExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'Original codex source controller did not confirm cleanup' }
      - name: Qualify original claude source A B with TEST peer
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $build = $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD
          $controller = "$build\Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe"
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $runner = Join-Path $PWD 'node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs'
          $tsconfig = Join-Path $PWD 'tsconfig.json'
          $gate = Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeEmulatedProviderGate.ts'
          $receipt = Join-Path $PWD 'process-acceptance-evidence\windows-source-claude-receipt.json'
          & $controller $node $runner --tsconfig $tsconfig $gate "$env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-fixture.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-birth-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-accounting-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-release-delay.exe" "$env:HOST_PROCESS_SCOPED_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" $receipt --test-source-provider claude 2>&1 | Tee-Object process-acceptance-evidence/windows-source-claude.log
          $controllerExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
          [ordered]@{ kind = 'TEST_SOURCE_CONTROLLER_EXIT'; provider = 'claude'; exitCode = [int]$controllerExitCode } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
          if ($controllerExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'Original claude source controller did not confirm cleanup' }
      - name: Qualify original opencode source A B with TEST peer
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $build = $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD
          $controller = "$build\Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe"
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $runner = Join-Path $PWD 'node_modules\tsx\dist\cli.mjs'
          $tsconfig = Join-Path $PWD 'tsconfig.json'
          $gate = Join-Path $PWD 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeEmulatedProviderGate.ts'
          $receipt = Join-Path $PWD 'process-acceptance-evidence\windows-source-opencode-receipt.json'
          & $controller $node $runner --tsconfig $tsconfig $gate "$env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-fixture.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-birth-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-accounting-failure.exe" "$build\Release\owned-process-broker-release-delay.exe" "$env:HOST_PROCESS_SCOPED_STAGE\owned-process-broker.exe" $receipt --test-source-provider opencode 2>&1 | Tee-Object process-acceptance-evidence/windows-source-opencode.log
          $controllerExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
          [ordered]@{ kind = 'TEST_SOURCE_CONTROLLER_EXIT'; provider = 'opencode'; exitCode = [int]$controllerExitCode } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
          if ($controllerExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'Original opencode source controller did not confirm cleanup' }
      - name: Require completed original platform receipts and unchanged source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD"
          git diff --exit-code
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { join } from 'node:path';
          const directory = 'process-acceptance-evidence';
          const rows = name => readFileSync(join(directory, name), 'utf8').split('\n')
            .filter(line => line.startsWith('{')).map(line => JSON.parse(line));
          const native = [];
          if (process.platform === 'linux') {
            for (const name of ['linux-node24.log', 'linux-electron.log']) {
              const completed = rows(name).filter(row => row.automaticAndWarm === true);
              assert.equal(completed.length, 1, 'one original complete Linux invocation');
              const receipt = completed[0];
              assert.equal(receipt.completed, true); assert.equal(receipt.cleaned, true);
              assert.match(receipt.binarySha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
              assert.match(receipt.manifestSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
              native.push({ log: name, scope: 'original Linux pidfs and retained pidfd', receipt });
            }
          } else if (process.platform === 'win32') {
            for (const name of ['windows-node24.log', 'windows-electron.log']) {
              const facts = rows(name);
              const gates = facts.filter(row => row.gate === 'owned-process-native-scenarios-only');
              const controllers = facts.filter(row => row.gateController);
              assert.equal(gates.length, 1); assert.equal(controllers.length, 1);
              assert.equal(gates[0].platform, 'win32'); assert.equal(gates[0].arch, process.arch);
              assert.ok(gates[0].results.includes('captured-provider-native-argv-env-cwd-and-stop'));
              assert.ok(gates[0].results.includes('TEST-only-debug-service-prebirth-nested-job-feasibility'));
              assert.ok(gates[0].results.includes('TEST-only-direct-I386-root-startup-and-late-application-exceptions'));
              assert.deepEqual(controllers[0], { gateController: 'drained', rootExitCode: 0, activeProcesses: 0 });
              native.push({ log: name, scope: 'original Windows Job, control and C++ fixture',
                scenarios: gates[0].results, cleanup: controllers[0] });
            }
            const emulated = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(directory, 'windows-emulated-provider-receipt.json'), 'utf8'));
            assert.equal(emulated.kind, 'TEST_WINDOWS_EMULATED_PROVIDER_PARITY');
            assert.equal(emulated.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(emulated.cleanup, true);
            assert.equal(emulated.sourceHead, process.env.HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(emulated.platform, 'win32-' + process.arch); assert.equal(emulated.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');
            assert.equal(emulated.realProviderExecuted, false); assert.equal(emulated.desktopQualified, false);
            assert.equal(emulated.releaseQualified, false);
            assert.deepEqual(emulated.wrappers, ['npm-node', 'generated-bun', 'opaque-cmd', 'positional-bat', 'npm-native']);
            assert.deepEqual(emulated.providers.map(row => row.provider), ['codex', 'opencode']);
            for (const row of emulated.providers) {
              for (const field of ['nativeReady', 'inputCompleted', 'neighborSurvivedPrimary', 'providerSurvivedScopedStops', 'cleanup']) assert.equal(row[field], true);
              assert.equal(row.registeredServices, 2); assert.equal(row.scopedStops, 2);
              for (const field of ['allocate', 'prepare', 'resume', 'release']) assert.equal(row.counts[field], 1);
              for (const field of ['serviceCapture', 'serviceStop', 'serviceSettle']) assert.equal(row.counts[field], 2);
              assert.ok(row.counts.stop >= 1 && row.counts.stop <= 4);
            }
            const controllers = rows('windows-emulated-provider.log').filter(row => row.gateController);
            assert.deepEqual(controllers, [{ gateController: 'drained', rootExitCode: 0, activeProcesses: 0 }]);
            native.push({ log: 'windows-emulated-provider.log', scope: 'captured Windows wrappers and Main Host Codex/V1 adapters with Node peers', receipt: emulated });
            const sourceReceipts = [
              ['codex', 'windows-source-codex-receipt.json', 'windows-source-codex.log'],
              ['claude', 'windows-source-claude-receipt.json', 'windows-source-claude.log'],
              ['opencode', 'windows-source-opencode-receipt.json', 'windows-source-opencode.log'],
            ];
            for (const [provider, receiptFile, log] of sourceReceipts) {
              const proof = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(directory, receiptFile), 'utf8'));
              assert.equal(proof.kind, 'TEST_WINDOWS_EMULATED_SOURCE_PARITY'); assert.equal(proof.provider, provider);
              assert.equal(proof.sourceHead, process.env.HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD);
              assert.equal(proof.platform, 'win32-' + process.arch); assert.equal(proof.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');
              assert.equal(proof.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(proof.cleanup, true);
              assert.equal(proof.realProviderExecuted, false); assert.equal(proof.desktopQualified, false); assert.equal(proof.releaseQualified, false);
              assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(proof, 'providers'), false); assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(proof, 'wrappers'), false);
              assert.equal(proof.sourceScenarios.length, 1);
              const row = proof.sourceScenarios[0]; assert.equal(row.provider, provider);
              assert.equal(row.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(row.stage, 'complete'); assert.equal(row.cleanup, true);
              assert.equal(row.realProviderExecuted, false); assert.equal(row.desktopQualified, false); assert.equal(row.releaseQualified, false);
              assert.equal(row.foreignScopeGrantRefusedBeforeAllocation, true);
              assert.notEqual(row.selections.A.revision, row.selections.B.revision);
              assert.equal(row.management.metadataRead, true); assert.equal(row.management.modelProbeCompleted, true);
              assert.equal(row.management.modelProbeInputs, 1); assert.equal(row.management.modelProbeReplayAllocated, false);
              assert.equal(row.management.metadataHostRetained, row.provider === 'opencode');
              assert.equal(row.teams.length, 2);
              assert.deepEqual(row.teams.map(team => team.source.revision), [row.selections.A.revision, row.selections.B.revision]);
              for (const field of ['currentB', 'retainedA', 'lookup']) assert.equal(row.cold[field], true);
              assert.equal(row.cold.physicalReplayAllocations, 0); assert.equal(row.cold.originalInputsReplayed, false);
              assert.deepEqual(row.cold.sourcePublishPendingAdmission, { admitted: 1, revoked: 1 });
              assert.equal(row.cold.sdkPeerCheckpointRestored, row.provider === 'claude');
              if (row.provider === 'claude') {
                assert.equal(row.cold.originalNativeSessionRetained, true);
                assert.equal(row.cold.source.revision, row.selections.A.revision);
              }
              if (row.provider === 'opencode') assert.equal(row.standalone.supported, false);
              else {
                assert.equal(row.standalone.phase, 'completed'); assert.equal(row.standalone.ephemeral, true);
                assert.equal(row.standalone.replayAllocated, false); assert.equal(row.standalone.source.revision, row.selections.B.revision);
              }
              assert.equal(row.epochs.length, 2); assert.ok(row.epochs[0].jobs.length > 0);
              for (const epoch of row.epochs) {
                assert.equal(epoch.serviceOperations, 0);
                for (const job of epoch.jobs) for (const field of ['resumed', 'stopped', 'drained', 'released', 'originalHandleAbsent']) assert.equal(job[field], true);
              }
              const originalController = rows(log).filter(value => value.gateController);
              assert.deepEqual(originalController, [{ gateController: 'drained', rootExitCode: 0, activeProcesses: 0 }]);
              native.push({ log, scope: 'captured Main Host source A/B with finite ' + provider + ' peer', receipt: proof });
            }
          } else assert.equal(process.platform, 'darwin');
          writeFileSync(join(directory, 'scope.json'), JSON.stringify({
            kind: 'TEST_HOST_PROCESS_FIXTURE_ACCEPTANCE', status: 'PASS',
            sourceHead: process.env.HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD, platform: process.env.HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM,
            nodeVersion: process.version, controlledContracts: true, retainedMainTransport: true,
            posixProcessGroups: process.platform !== 'win32', native,
            nativeProviderRuntimeQualified: false, darwinNativeRegistrationQualified: false,
            posixExecutableAdmissionQualified: false, desktopQualified: false, releaseQualified: false,
          }, null, 2) + '\n');
          NODE
      - name: Preserve original process evidence including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: host-process-fixtures-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            native-evidence/
            process-acceptance-evidence/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-process-node24-${{ github.run_id }}/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-process-electron-${{ github.run_id }}/

# Darwin covers real controlled POSIX lifecycle plus contract tests here. Its registered-token
# native admission and the known POSIX executable mutation feasibility failure remain separate.
# No vendor CLI, vendor login, remote model server or production tuple admission runs here.
# Claude SDK checks use only the finite Node peer and the local TEST Host MCP.

name: OpenCode V2 Stage1 static preflight (TEST only)

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      # The preflight test reads the actual Stage1 runtime lock and builds
      # the pinned provider package; changing either must invalidate its proof.
      - runtime.lock.json
      - pnpm-lock.yaml
      # Root manifest/workspace membership and Host TS project files affect
      # this exact pinned install, build and source test, even without a lock change.
      - package.json
      - pnpm-workspace.yaml
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/package.json
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/tsconfig*.json
      # The job builds the full Host package and typechecks its TEST tree;
      # every Host source/test change invalidates the exact native proof.
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/src/**
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/**
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/native/**
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/**
      - scripts/legacy-agent-host/**
      - scripts/stage-runtime.mjs
      - scripts/lib/opencode-v2-base-inventory.mts
      - scripts/lib/runtime-archive-checksum.mjs
      - scripts/lib/runtime-payload-cache.mjs
      # Selection/update policy is tested with the same pinned Node/workspace.
      - src/features/opencode-runtime-installer/**
      - src/features/opencode-compatibility/**
      - src/main/services/infrastructure/openCode*.ts
      - src/main/services/runtime/openCode*.ts
      - src/main/services/infrastructure/OpenCodeRuntimeInstallerService.ts
      - src/main/services/infrastructure/openCodeRuntimePackageMetadata.ts
      - test/features/opencode-runtime-installer/**
      - test/main/services/infrastructure/OpenCodeRuntimeInstallerService.test.ts
      - vendor/provider-migration/**
      - scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs
      - .github/workflows/opencode-v2-stage1-preflight.yml

# Canonical PR supersession; never cancel main/tag/manual evidence.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  static-preflight:
    name: Static V01 source test (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-2022]
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Enable Windows long paths
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable PR source HEAD
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_PR_HEAD"
      # Read the actual moving Desktop product lock separately from this
      # historical Stage1 stacked checkout. The test requires both releases
      # to agree before returning even a static read-only candidate.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          path: .current-product-lock
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: runtime.lock.json
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - name: Record exact current product commit
        shell: bash
        run: git -C .current-product-lock rev-parse HEAD
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prove retry classification on the exact source HEAD
        run: node --test test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs
      - name: Install pinned workspace dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build Stage1 Host without launching providers
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Typecheck Host TEST contracts
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host typecheck:test
      - name: Verify captured and native model variants through Host SPI
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-model-variant.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-model-variant-spi.test.ts
      - name: Verify generation-preserving install and update policy
        run: pnpm exec vitest run test/features/opencode-runtime-installer/installPolicy.test.ts test/main/services/infrastructure/OpenCodeRuntimeInstallerService.test.ts
      - name: Execute V2 static preflight, current-main lock and FIFO negatives
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_CURRENT_PRODUCT_LOCK: ${{ github.workspace }}/.current-product-lock/runtime.lock.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-static-preflight.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-static-capture.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-host-spi.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-receipt.test.mjs packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-process-guard.test.mjs packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-request-admission.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v1-version-receipt.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v1-version-source.test.ts
      - name: Native V1 baseline and latest Host compatibility (Linux TEST)
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-24.04'
        timeout-minutes: 20
        env:
          OPENCODE_V1_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: desktop
          ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: ''
        run: |
          node scripts/postinstall-electron.cjs
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v1-version-runner.ts
      - name: Preserve native V1 version evidence
        if: always() && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-24.04'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v1-version-host-linux
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: opencode-v1-version-evidence/*.json

  native-host-instructions:
    name: Native V2.0.21 Host SPI instructions (Ubuntu TEST only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      npm_config_audit: 'false'
      npm_config_fund: 'false'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable PR native source HEAD
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_PR_HEAD"
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install pinned Host workspace dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build Host V2 SPI with real pinned private driver
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Check native TEST proof syntax
        run: node --check packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-instructions.mjs
      - name: Test direct-shell HTTP mutation/no-replay diagnostic boundary
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-direct-shell-probe.test.mjs
      - name: Install exact official V2 CLI in isolated runner prefix, without scripts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli" && npm init -y)
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli" --save-exact \
            --package-lock=true --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund @opencode/cli@2.0.21
          npm ls --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli" --depth=0 @opencode/cli
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli/package-lock.json"
      - name: Confirm native ELF interruption and original process identity
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_NPM_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-host-cli/node_modules/@opencode
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-http-interrupt-negative.test.mjs
      - name: Exercise real pinned native server against existing Host Session SPI
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_NPM_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-host-cli/node_modules/@opencode
          OPENCODE_V2_HOST_NATIVE_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-instructions.mjs
      # Passing the native runner alone is not evidence: a missing receipt must
      # fail this job even when the pinned npm lockfile still uploads successfully.
      # Keep the always() upload below for sanitized failure/HOLD artifacts.
      - name: Require complete native TEST receipt before success
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-receipt-verify.mjs opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
      - name: Preserve exact native TEST proof or HOLD receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-stage1-host-native-instructions-ubuntu
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-host-cli/package-lock.json

  published-v2-http-persist:
    name: Published V2.0.21 durable HTTP process (TEST discovery only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      npm_config_audit: 'false'
      npm_config_fund: 'false'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable PR source HEAD
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_PR_HEAD"
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install exact private Stage1 Session SPI dependencies
        env:
          AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build isolated Stage1 V2 Session SPI for TEST-only HTTP proof
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Check isolated durable-HTTP TEST harness syntax
        run: node --check packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-published-http-persist.mjs
      - name: Check TEST shell-flag permission split diagnostic (no tool execution)
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-shell-flag-policy-probe.test.mjs
      - name: Negative SDK setup cleanup and HOLD receipt (no worker launch)
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Install official pinned SDK without scripts in TEST-owned npm prefix
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-http-test"
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-http-test" \
            --save-exact --package-lock=true --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund @opencode/sdk@2.0.21
          npm ls --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-http-test" --depth=0 @opencode/sdk
      - name: Negative valid-SDK post-copy cleanup cannot touch shared package prefix
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SDK_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-http-test
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-http-setup-negative.test.mjs
      - name: Negative owned-worker cleanup on parent SIGINT and SIGTERM
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SDK_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-http-test
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-http-interrupt-negative.test.mjs
      - name: Probe actual published server HTTP durable-log and cold restart
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SDK_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-http-test
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_HTTP_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-http-persist.json
        run: node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-published-http-persist.mjs
      - name: Require exact-HEAD TEST receipt (never a Host/model certificate)
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s opencode-v2-http-persist.json
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('opencode-v2-http-persist.json','utf8'));
            if(r.sourceHead!==process.env.EXPECTED_PR_HEAD ||
               r.kind!=='TEST_V2_HTTP_DURABLE_DISCOVERY' || r.qualified!==false ||
               r.packagedElectronQualified!==false || r.modelTurnProven!==false ||
               r.processCustodyQualified!==false || r.cleanup!==true ||
               r.durableHTTPEvents!==1 || r.hostSpiReadinessProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSessionPermissionOrderReadbackProven!==true ||
               r.nativeShellFlagPermissionSplitObserved!==true ||
               r.nativePermissionResolverProven!==true ||
               r.nativePermissionReplyRejectNoReplayProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSavedAlwaysOverridesAskProven!==true ||
               r.nativeExplicitDenyBeatsSavedAlwaysProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSavedGrantSurvivesColdRestartProven!==true ||
               r.nativeFreshSessionSavedGrantSurvivesColdRestartProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSavedGrantRemainsProjectScopedAfterRestartProven!==true ||
               r.nativeUnauthenticatedDeleteRejected!==true ||
               r.nativeUnauthenticatedPermissionGrantRejected!==true ||
               r.nativeStalePermissionAfterRestartRejected!==true ||
               r.nativeStaleGrantAfterRestartRejected!==true ||
               r.failure !== undefined) process.exit(1);
            // A fabricated six-element receipt is not a completed native proof.
            // Require each physical TEST stage in its original order.
            const requiredSteps=[
              'TEST_published_server_real_authenticated_HTTP_ready',
              'TEST_no_unauthenticated_HTTP_access',
              'TEST_native_shell_flag_permission_split_not_tool_enforcement',
              'TEST_native_unauthenticated_mutations_rejected',
              'TEST_published_native_permission_resolver_and_nonreplay',
              'TEST_real_pending_permission_exists_before_cold_restart',
              'TEST_official_HTTP_session_created_event_persisted',
              'TEST_cold_native_permission_not_replayed_or_accepted',
              'TEST_native_persisted_always_vs_deny_survives_cold_restart',
              'TEST_durable_HTTP_session_identity_survives_cold_restart_no_prompt',
              'TEST_real_published_HTTP_Stage1_SPI_ready_no_model_turn',
              'TEST_Stage1_SPI_readiness_recheck_and_owned_cleanup_no_replay',
            ];
            if(!Array.isArray(r.steps) || r.steps.length!==requiredSteps.length ||
               r.steps.some((step,index)=>step!==requiredSteps[index])) process.exit(1);
          "
      - name: Preserve TEST-only receipt on success or safe failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-published-http-persist-ubuntu
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: opencode-v2-http-persist.json

  embedded-v2-native-host:
    name: Embedded V2.1.4 original Host (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux-x64
            candidate-build: ''
          - os: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
            candidate-build: 24H232
          - os: macos-15-intel
            platform: darwin-x64
            candidate-build: 24G830
          - os: windows-2022
            platform: win32-x64
            candidate-build: ''
          - os: windows-11-arm
            platform: win32-arm64
            candidate-build: ''
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      npm_config_audit: 'false'
      npm_config_fund: 'false'
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_DARWIN_CANDIDATE_BUILD: ${{ matrix.candidate-build }}
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_INPUTS_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-embedded-inputs.json
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CUSTODY_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-darwin-custody.json
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_WINDOWS_CUSTODY_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-windows-custody.json
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-embedded-host.json
    steps:
      - name: Enable Windows long paths
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable source HEAD and record actual runner tuple
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD"
          uname -sm
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = macOS ]; then /usr/sbin/sysctl -n kern.osversion; fi
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install exact source workspace dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build original Host and its pinned provider implementation
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Check original graph and custody boundaries
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-embedded-graph.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-build-selection.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-job-custody.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-paths.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/owner-scoped-backup.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/member-attachment-delivery.test.ts
      - name: Stage checksum-pinned base archive without executing the legacy CLI
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Prepare exact Bun, engine graph and original-process artifact
        run: node --import tsx scripts/legacy-agent-host/prepare-opencode-v2-native.ts
      - name: Prove actual Darwin executable custody and adversarial cleanup
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CUSTODY_GO: '1'
        run: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-executable.native.ts
      - name: Require complete Darwin evidence for this exact candidate or product tuple
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CUSTODY_RECEIPT, 'utf8'));
            const candidate = process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED !== '1';
            assert.equal(r.kind, candidate ? 'TEST_DARWIN_CUSTODY_CANDIDATE' : 'TEST_DARWIN_CUSTODY_PRODUCT_PATH');
            assert.equal(r.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(r.platform + '-' + r.arch, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM);
            assert.equal(r.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.cleanup, 'confirmed');
            assert.equal(r.productQualified, false);
            assert.equal(r.replacementRefused, true);
            assert.equal(r.siblingSurvivedTargetStop, true);
            assert.equal(r.bunSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.processArtifactManifestSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PROCESS_CUSTODY_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            assert.notEqual(r.original.startIdentity, r.sibling.startIdentity);
            if (candidate) assert.equal(r.osBuild, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_DARWIN_CANDIDATE_BUILD);
          "
      - name: Prove original Windows Job custody and surviving descendant cleanup
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_WINDOWS_CUSTODY_GO: '1'
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-job-custody.native.ts
      - name: Require exact Windows original-process evidence
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_WINDOWS_CUSTODY_RECEIPT, 'utf8'));
            assert.equal(r.kind, 'TEST_WINDOWS_ORIGINAL_JOB_CUSTODY');
            assert.equal(r.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(r.platform, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM);
            assert.equal(r.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');
            assert.equal(r.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.cleanup, true);
            assert.equal(r.captureBeforeInput, true);
            assert.equal(r.descendantSurvivedRootExit, true);
            assert.equal(r.originalJobCleanup, 'confirmed');
            assert.equal(r.neighborSurvivedTargetStop, true);
            assert.equal(r.neighborJobCleanup, 'confirmed');
            assert.equal(r.bunSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.manifestSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.productQualified, false); assert.equal(r.desktopQualified, false);
          "
      - name: Check original Desktop private recipe composition
        if: env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1' && runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: node --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-opencode-v2-fixture.test.ts
      - name: Exercise native model, tool, MCP, approval, Stop and cold Host Resume
        if: env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_GO: '1'
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-embedded-host.native.ts
      - name: Exercise Windows automatic approval and cold Host Resume
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_APPROVAL_MODE: auto
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-embedded-host-auto.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-embedded-host.native.ts
      - name: Exercise native catalog and model probe without tool allocation
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_MODEL_PROBE_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_MODEL_PROBE_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-model-probe.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-model-probe.native.ts
      - name: Exercise native key connection, saved-key reuse and cold original-intent recovery
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_CREDENTIAL_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_CREDENTIAL_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-credentials.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-credentials.native.ts
      - name: Exercise effective permissions and active Stop with a surviving sibling
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_PERMISSION_LIFECYCLE_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_PERMISSION_LIFECYCLE_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.native.ts
      - name: Exercise captured external MCP and app-only through the native Host
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-captured-mcp.json
        run: |
          node --check packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/fixtures/native-opencode-v2-mcp/server.mjs
          node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-captured-mcp.native.ts
      - name: Require complete native management and permission evidence
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          for (const [path, kind] of [
            ['opencode-v2-model-probe.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_MODEL_PROBE'],
            ['opencode-v2-credentials.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CREDENTIAL'],
            ['opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_PERMISSION_LIFECYCLE'],
            ['opencode-v2-captured-mcp.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP'],
          ]) {
            const receipt = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
            assert.equal(receipt.kind, kind);
            assert.equal(receipt.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(receipt.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(receipt.cleanup, true);
            assert.equal(receipt.digests.bun, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(receipt.digests.manifest, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            if (kind === 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_MODEL_PROBE') {
              assert.equal(receipt.configurationSource, 'global-symlink-project-regular');
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.requests, [
                { tools: 0, promptMatched: true, model: 'TEST-model', configScope: 'global' },
                { tools: 0, promptMatched: true, model: 'TEST-model-B', effort: 'high', configScope: 'project' },
                { tools: 0, promptMatched: true, model: 'TEST-model-B', effort: 'high', configScope: 'project' },
              ]);
              assert.ok(receipt.steps.includes('unlisted_variant_refused_without_model_request_and_owned_cleanup_confirmed'));
              assert.ok(receipt.steps.includes('published_global_and_project_sources_reached_native_body_headers_limits_and_default'));

            if (kind === 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP') {
              assert.equal(receipt.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');
              assert.equal(receipt.version, '2.1.4');
              assert.equal(receipt.manualPermissionBeforeEffect, true);
              assert.equal(receipt.excludedProcessStarts, 0);
              assert.equal(receipt.externalProcessStarts, 1);
              assert.equal(receipt.externalToolCalls, 1);
              assert.equal(receipt.externalProcessCloses, 1);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.modelFailures, []);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.modelRequests.map(row => [row.turn, row.step]), [
                ['ALLOW', 0], ['ALLOW', 1], ['ALLOW', 2], ['APP_ONLY', 0], ['APP_ONLY', 1],
              ]);
              assert.equal(receipt.modelRequests[0].tool, 'TEST_selected_write_marker');
              assert.ok(receipt.modelRequests.filter(row => row.tool?.endsWith('message_send')).length === 2);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.steps, [
                'captured_allowlist_actual_tool_once_permission_original_result_and_cleanup',
                'app_only_has_no_external_tool_or_process_and_preserves_team_reply',
                'cold_original_receipts_and_readback_do_not_replay_native_or_external_tools',
              ]);
              assert.equal(receipt.hosts.length, 2);
              assert.ok(receipt.hosts.every(row => row.exitCode === 0 && row.signalCode === null && row.stdoutValid));
              assert.equal(receipt.vendorAuthQualified, false);
              assert.equal(receipt.desktopQualified, false);
              assert.equal(receipt.releaseQualified, false);
            }
            if (kind === 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CREDENTIAL') {
              assert.equal(receipt.nativeCredentialCount, 3);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.requests, ['refused', 'OK', 'OK', 'timeout'].map(outcome => ({
                authorizationMatched: true, tools: 0, promptMatched: true, outcome,
              })));
              for (const step of [
                'passive_all_provider_directory_without_import_or_inference',
                'native_key_one_verification_original_receipt_after_lost_ack',
                'native_401_saved_unverified_then_cold_explicit_corrected_key_succeeds',
                'runtime_source_revision_preserves_original_rejected_key_replacement_authority',
                'cold_directory_and_explicit_check_reuse_saved_selected_key',
                'cold_unverified_original_intent_blocks_changed_key_and_new_id_without_replay',
                'selected_native_db_only_foreign_auth_preserved_secret_free_receipts',
              ]) assert.ok(receipt.steps.includes(step));
              assert.equal(receipt.vendorAuthQualified, false);
            }
          }
          NODE
      - name: Require product-path Host proof after exact candidate qualification
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            assert.equal(process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED, '1',
              'HOLD: candidate custody evidence is available; qualify only this exact tuple and rerun the unmodified product path');
            const receipts = [[process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_RECEIPT, 'manual']];
            if (process.platform === 'win32') receipts.push(['opencode-v2-embedded-host-auto.json', 'auto']);
            for (const [path, mode] of receipts) {
            const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
            assert.equal(r.kind, 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST');
            assert.equal(r.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(r.platform, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM);
            assert.equal(r.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.cleanup, true);
            assert.equal(r.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0'); assert.equal(r.version, '2.1.4');
            assert.equal(r.approvalMode, mode); assert.equal(r.modelRequests, 11);
            assert.deepEqual(r.modelSelection,
              { providerId: 'TEST-local', modelId: 'TEST-model-B', variant: 'high' });
            assert.deepEqual(r.configurationSelection,
              { scope: 'project', original: 'project-A', later: 'project-B' });
            assert.deepEqual(r.preferencesSelection,
              { nativeDefault: 'TEST-local/TEST-model', appDefault: 'TEST-local/TEST-model-B' });
            assert.deepEqual(r.modelFailures, []);
            assert.equal(r.digests.bun, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.digests.manifest, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            const coordination = process.platform === 'linux' && process.arch === 'x64';
            if (coordination) {
              assert.equal(r.coordination.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.coordination.cleanup, true);
            }
            assert.deepEqual(r.steps, [
              ...(coordination ? ['original_native_coordination_and_cleanup_before_business_host'] : []),
              'original_host_embedded_native_and_mcp_ready',
              'native_model_tool_effect_permission_mcp_task_and_reply_completed_once',
              'changed_project_config_did_not_retarget_running_native_session',
              'original_uploaded_PNG_native_image_inference_and_public_readback',
              'checkpoint_and_original_host_native_cleanup_confirmed',
              'cold_host_restored_native_history_without_model_or_tool_replay',
            ]);
            assert.equal(r.vendorAuthQualified, false);
            assert.equal(r.desktopQualified, false); assert.equal(r.releaseQualified, false);
            if (process.platform === 'win32') assert.match(r.digests.windowsShell, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
            }
          "
      - name: Observe POSIX original-path exec and explicit mutation counterexamples
        if: always() && runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_POSIX_EXEC_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_POSIX_EXEC_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-posix-exec.json
