          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CANDIDATE_BUILD: ''
        run: node --test --test-name-pattern='^POSIX original-path' packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-executable.native.ts
      - name: Preserve exact native evidence or candidate HOLD
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-embedded-native-${{ matrix.platform }}
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            opencode-v2-embedded-inputs.json
            opencode-v2-darwin-custody.json
            opencode-v2-windows-custody.json
            opencode-v2-embedded-host.json
            opencode-v2-embedded-host-auto.json
            opencode-v2-model-probe.json
            opencode-v2-credentials.json
            opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.json
            opencode-v2-captured-mcp.json
            opencode-v2-posix-exec.json

name: Electron packaged CI

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, labeled, unlabeled, edited]
    # No GitHub paths filter: its 3,000-file cap can silently skip Host/provider changes.
    # The checked-out exact local git diff is classified by packaged-ci-cli.mts.

permissions:
  contents: read

# Metadata edits use unique groups and noncanonical check names, even if setup fails.
# A title/body edit must never cancel or replace checks for the same code.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}-${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && format('metadata-{0}', github.run_id) || 'checks' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !(github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body)) }}

jobs:
  packaged-scope:
    name: classify packaged smoke
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.scope }}
      run: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Verify packaged CI policy contracts
        run: node --test scripts/ci/packaged-ci-policy.test.mts
      - name: Test provider archive integrity gate
        run: node --test scripts/ci/packaged-ci-provider-integrity.test.ts
      - name: Classify exact local PR diff
        id: scope
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-cli.mts classify

  packaged-smoke:
    needs: packaged-scope
    if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run == 'true' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    name: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'metadata packaged smoke' || 'packaged smoke' }} (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: darwin-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: darwin
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}
            pack: pack:mac:arm64
            bundle: release/mac-arm64/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: darwin-x64
            arch: x64
            os: darwin
            runner: macos-15-intel
            pack: pack:mac:x64
            bundle: release/mac/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: win32-x64
            arch: x64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-2022
            pack: pack:win:x64
            bundle: release/win-unpacked
          - platform: win32-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-11-arm
            pack: pack:win:arm64
            bundle: release/win-arm64-unpacked
          - platform: linux-x64
            arch: x64
            os: linux
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
            pack: pack:linux
            bundle: release/linux-unpacked

    env:
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}

    steps:
      - name: Enable Windows long paths
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        if: matrix.os != 'darwin'
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Linux packaging tools
        if: matrix.os == 'linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libarchive-tools rpm xvfb
      - name: Restore node-gyp executable bit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          for root in "$(pnpm store path)" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"; do
            if [ -d "$root" ]; then
              find "$root" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done
      - name: Verify selected provider archives against frozen lock before install
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-provider-integrity.ts
      - name: Install frozen dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Verify managed Git pins and archive path safety
        run: node --test scripts/stage-managed-git.test.mjs
      - name: Validate packaged OpenCode project-path smoke syntax early
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        run: node --check scripts/e2e/opencode-project-path-packaged.mjs
      - name: Typecheck packaged CI policy with pinned compiler
        run: node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.packaged-ci.json
      - name: Assert Electron binary was provisioned during install
        run: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const root=path.dirname(require.resolve('electron/package.json')); const marker=path.join(root,'path.txt'); if(!fs.existsSync(marker) || !fs.existsSync(path.join(root,'dist',fs.readFileSync(marker,'utf8')))) process.exit(1)"
      - name: Test bundled undici security version policy
        run: node --test test/scripts/verify-bundled-undici.test.cjs
      - name: Verify CI Node and Electron built-in undici versions
        run: node scripts/ci/verify-bundled-undici.cjs
      - name: Verify native rebuild
        run: pnpm exec electron-rebuild -f -o node-pty,ssh2,cpu-features,better-sqlite3
      - name: Stage bundled runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Stage terminal platform runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Stage Windows console wrapper
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        run: node ./scripts/stage-opencode-console-wrapper.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }} --require
      - name: Build app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Select exact Host Node for candidate staging
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Prepare actual pinned V2 Bun, engine and admitted process custody
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_INPUTS_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged-inputs.json
        run: node --import tsx scripts/legacy-agent-host/prepare-opencode-v2-native.ts
      - name: Prefill pinned macOS arm64 Host Node archive
        if: matrix.platform == 'darwin-arm64'
        run: node scripts/ci/prefill-legacy-host-macos-node.mts
      - name: Stage V2 Host closure in existing candidate extraResources
        run: node scripts/legacy-agent-host/stage-opencode-v2-packaged.ts
      - name: Typecheck and test packaged Host capture boundaries
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.legacy-agent-host-scripts.json
          node --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/candidate-closure.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/packaged-opencode-v2-inputs.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/stage-node.test.ts
      - name: Verify and stage original Windows scoped broker for packaged Retry
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original broker compiler failed' }
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.retained-host.json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original retained Host compiler failed' }
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 --config tools/owned-process-broker/vitest.config.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original broker protocol cases failed' }
          node --check tools/owned-process-broker/nativeWindowsAppGate.mjs
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Packaged Windows driver syntax failed' }
          $build = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("TEST-Windows-UI-build-" + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + "-" + $env:RUNNER_ARCH)
          $stage = Join-Path $PWD 'resources\legacy-agent-host\windows-retry-custody'
          if (Test-Path $stage) { throw 'Windows Retry broker destination must be absent' }
          $cmake = (Get-Command cmake.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts ${{ matrix.arch }} $build $stage $cmake service-scopes-v1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original scoped broker stage failed' }
          "WINDOWS_RETRY_BUILD=$build" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Package unsigned test bundle
        env:
          CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false'
        # Only the two macOS commands omit DMG/ZIP in the intermediate draft lane.
        # Native rebuild, staging and every bundle smoke below remain mandatory.
        run: pnpm ${{ matrix.pack }} --publish never --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=false --config.mac.notarize=false ${{ matrix.os == 'darwin' && needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope == 'app' && '--dir' || '' }}
      - name: Verify bundle native architecture
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/verifyBundle.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke packaged SQLite and PTY modules
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedNative.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }}
      - name: Smoke packaged Git without external installation
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokeManagedGit.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke managed Git inside native Windows terminal
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokeManagedTerminalGit.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke packaged MCP handshake
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedMcp.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }}
      - name: Verify macOS 13 minimum
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        run: test "$(plutil -extract LSMinimumSystemVersion raw -o - '${{ matrix.bundle }}/Contents/Info.plist')" = '13.0'
      - name: Smoke packaged app
        if: matrix.os != 'linux'
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedApp.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }}
      - name: Qualify packaged macOS OpenCode project-path status and model list
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        run: node scripts/e2e/opencode-project-path-packaged.mjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}"
      - name: Smoke packaged app under Xvfb
        if: matrix.os == 'linux'
        run: xvfb-run -a node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedApp.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" linux
      - name: Qualify actual packaged V2 Host tools, MCP, Stop and cold Resume
        # The runner restores its disposable checkout and the intact legacy payload
        # in finally. No parent shell may keep the Windows checkout as its cwd.
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_PACKAGED_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged.json
        run: node "${{ github.workspace }}/scripts/legacy-agent-host/run-packaged-opencode-v2.ts" "${{ matrix.bundle }}" "${{ matrix.platform }}"
      - name: Qualify packaged Windows same-Main Retry and original Processes UI Kill with finite peers
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $bundle = (Resolve-Path '${{ matrix.bundle }}').Path
          $apps = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $bundle -File -Filter '*.exe' | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch 'uninstall' })
          if ($apps.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Expected one original packaged application executable' }
          $app = $apps[0].FullName
          $broker = Join-Path $bundle 'resources\legacy-agent-host\windows-retry-custody\owned-process-broker.exe'
          $query = Join-Path $env:WINDOWS_RETRY_BUILD 'Release\owned-process-fixture.exe'
          $receipt = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-same-main-process-ui.json'
          $controller = Join-Path $env:WINDOWS_RETRY_BUILD 'Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe'
          $controllerHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $controller).Hash
          $controllerLog = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-same-main-process-ui.controller.log'
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $loader = ([System.Uri]((Resolve-Path 'node_modules\tsx\dist\loader.mjs').Path)).AbsoluteUri
          $gate = (Resolve-Path 'tools\owned-process-broker\nativeWindowsAppGate.mjs').Path
          $env:TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH = (Resolve-Path 'tsconfig.json').Path
          & $controller $node --import $loader $gate $app $broker $query $receipt 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $controllerLog
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original controller did not confirm finite UI cleanup' }
          if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $controller).Hash -ne $controllerHash) { throw 'Original controller changed' }
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs';const b=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]);assert.ok(b.length>0&&b.length<=65536);const lines=b.toString('utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/u);const rows=lines.filter(line=>line.startsWith('{')).map(line=>JSON.parse(line)).filter(row=>row.gateController!==undefined);assert.deepEqual(rows,[{gateController:'drained',rootExitCode:0,activeProcesses:0}]);" $controllerLog
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Exact original controller accounting refused' }
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs';const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8'));assert.equal(r.kind,'TEST_WINDOWS_PACKAGED_SAME_MAIN_PROCESS_UI');assert.equal(r.status,'PASS');assert.equal(r.cleanup,true);assert.equal(r.sourceHead,process.env.EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA);assert.equal(r.platform,'win32-'+process.arch);assert.deepEqual(r.counts,{mainStarts:1,initialRuntimeOpen:1,businessInput:1,refreshClicks:1,retryClicks:1,uiStops:2,quit:1});assert.equal(r.actualHostSuccessors,1);assert.equal(r.originalRuntimeGenerations,1);assert.equal(r.modelRequests,0);assert.equal(r.modelProbes,0);assert.equal(r.realVendorExecutions,0);assert.equal(r.peer.provider,'codex');assert.equal(r.peer.connected,1);assert.equal(r.peer.registrations,1);assert.equal(r.peer.serviceExitObservations,2);assert.equal(r.peer.failures,0);assert.deepEqual(r.nativeCleanup,{phase:'completed',cleanup:true,originalQueryWitnesses:3,runtimeGenerations:1,runtimeInputs:1,modelRequests:0,probes:0,realVendorExecutions:0,originalUiStops:2,serviceExitObservations:2});assert.equal(r.packagedAndNativeInputsUnchanged,true);assert.equal(r.sourceFreezeFailure,undefined);assert.equal(r.peerEvidenceFailure,undefined);assert.equal(r.originalMain.pid,r.sameMainAfterRetry.pid);assert.equal(r.originalMain.birth,r.sameMainAfterRetry.birth);" $receipt
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Exact finite same-Main UI receipt refused' }
      - name: Qualify original packaged macOS app relaunch with finite SDK peer
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        shell: bash
        env:
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
          LEGACY_DESKTOP_BACKEND_GO: '1'
          LEGACY_DESKTOP_EMULATED_ONLY: '1'
          LEGACY_DESKTOP_PROOF_MODE: emulated-claude-lifecycle-ui
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          inputs="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-packaged-relaunch-inputs-XXXXXX")"
          mkdir "$inputs/corepack"
          printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$inputs/corepack/package.json"
          pnpm --dir "$inputs/corepack" add --ignore-scripts --save-exact corepack@0.36.0
          node --import tsx scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-packaged-relaunch-smoke.ts \
            "${{ matrix.bundle }}" "$inputs/corepack/node_modules/corepack/dist/pnpm.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/packaged-app-relaunch.json"
      - name: Preserve exact packaged Host evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: packaged-v2-host-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged-inputs.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged-native.json
            ${{ github.workspace }}/resources/legacy-agent-host/opencode-v2-candidate.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-same-main-process-ui.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-same-main-process-ui.app.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-same-main-process-ui.controller.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-same-main-process-ui.*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/packaged-app-relaunch.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/packaged-app-relaunch.app.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/ui-emulated-lifecycle-launch.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/ui-emulated-lifecycle-stopped.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/ui-automatic-app-relaunch-successor.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/ui-packaged-relaunch-failure.png

  packaged-full-gate:
    needs: [packaged-scope, packaged-smoke]
    if: always() && !cancelled()
    name: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'metadata packaged gate' || 'packaged full gate' }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Require selected packaging verification
        if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope != 'full' || needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run != 'false'
        env:
          PACKAGED_SCOPE: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope }}
          SCOPE_RESULT: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.result }}
          PACKAGED_RESULT: ${{ needs.packaged-smoke.result }}
          PACKAGED_RUN: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run }}
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-cli.mts gate
      - name: Preserve existing code checks after metadata edits
        if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope == 'full' && needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run == 'false'
        run: echo 'Title/body edit only. Existing packaged code checks are unchanged.'

name: CI
# Immutable event inputs are available through run.display_title before jobs start.
run-name: >-
  ${{ format('CI proof: PR={0} | head={1} | base={2} | merge={3} | action={4} | draft={5}', github.event.pull_request.number || 0, github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha, github.event.pull_request.base.sha || 'none', github.sha, github.event.action || github.event_name, github.event.pull_request.draft && 'true' || 'false') }}

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      # Long-lived integration branches: pushes here previously ran no CI at all,
      # which let multi-day test regressions land unnoticed (they only surfaced
      # through PR #252's merge CI).
      - refactor/team-provisioning-round2-reapply
      - refactor/hosted-web-feature-boundaries
  pull_request:
    types:
      [
        opened,
        synchronize,
        reopened,
        ready_for_review,
        converted_to_draft,
        edited,
        labeled,
        unlabeled,
      ]
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      stage1_desktop:
        description: Run existing Stage 1 source Desktop controls with isolated localhost fixtures
        type: boolean
        default: false
      stage1_process_diagnostic:
        description: Record an unqualified current macOS tuple diagnostic with one owned finite Node child
        type: boolean
        default: false
      stage1_process_qualification:
        description: Run fresh TEST kernel ancestry, normal SDK Stop and unsigned packed Launch on the exact prospective tuple
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
# Every edited event is additionally isolated before the stricter Node classifier
# runs. Even malformed edits or failed planning must not cancel current-code CI.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && format('edited-{0}', github.run_id) || 'checks' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action != 'edited' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

env:
  CI_ROOT_TEST_SHARDS: '4'

jobs:
  plan:
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'Metadata CI plan' || 'plan' }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.scope }}
      full: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.full }}
      metadata: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.metadata }}
      reuse: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.reuse }}
      source_run: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.source_run }}
      image: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.image }}
      linux_arch: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.linux_arch }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: "CI source proof: PR=${{ github.event.pull_request.number || 0 }} | base=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || 'none' }} | head=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"
        run: echo 'Source event identity recorded in job metadata'
      - name: Plan feedback and verify reusable evidence
        id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CI_LINUX_RUNNER: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
        run: |
          node --test test/scripts/ciOptionalWorkflows.test.mts
          node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts plan

  feedback:
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && (needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'false') && 'Metadata fast feedback' || 'Fast feedback' }}
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.full == 'false' && needs.plan.outputs.metadata == 'false'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      # Force exit: a broken gate wait loop must fail this step, not hang it.
      - name: Test feedback policy
        run: node --test --test-force-exit test/scripts/ciFeedback*.test.mts test/scripts/ciChangeScope*.test.mts test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Guard runtime artifacts
        run: node ./scripts/ci/forbid-runtime-artifacts.cjs
      - name: Guard production source file size
        run: node ./scripts/ci/check-source-file-size.mjs
      - name: Guard Team Provisioning architecture
        run: node ./scripts/ci/check-team-provisioning-architecture.mjs
      - name: Typecheck workspace
        run: pnpm typecheck:workspace
      - name: Fast lint
        run: pnpm lint:fast

  validate:
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && (needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'false') && 'Metadata validate' || 'validate' }}
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.full == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.scope == 'full'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Guard runtime artifacts

          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
          import { appendFileSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';

          assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(pin).sort(), ['binarySha256', 'manifestPath', 'manifestSha256']);
          assert.equal(pin.manifestPath, join(dirname(process.argv[2]), 'linux-child-exec/manifest.json'));
          assert.equal(realpathSync(pin.manifestPath), pin.manifestPath);
          const digest = path => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');
          assert.match(pin.manifestSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
          assert.equal(digest(pin.manifestPath), pin.manifestSha256);
          const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pin.manifestPath, 'utf8'));
          assert.equal(manifest.protocol, 'linux-child-exec-v1');
          assert.equal(manifest.sourceSha256, digest('packages/legacy-agent-host/native/linux-child-exec.c'));
          assert.equal(manifest.binarySha256, pin.binarySha256);
          assert.equal(digest(join(dirname(pin.manifestPath), 'linux-child-exec')), pin.binarySha256);
          assert.ok(!/[\r\n]/.test(pin.manifestPath));
          appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_MANIFEST=${pin.manifestPath}\nLEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_SHA256=${pin.manifestSha256}\n`);

  codex-login-desktop:
    name: Codex login Desktop (Linux x64)
    # Bounded frontend-parity qualification, including a Ready stacked test PR.
    # This does not change Stage 1's broader native/UI gate or qualify account completion.
    needs: plan
    if: >-
      needs.plan.outputs.metadata == 'false' &&
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'feat/provider-host-frontend-parity-20261112' ||
       github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'feat/provider-host-frontend-parity-20261112')
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubicloud-standard-4' }}
    timeout-minutes: 41
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      CODEX_LOGIN_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare private Linux display dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(uname -m)" = x86_64
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CODEX_LOGIN_SOURCE_HEAD"
          printf 'TMPDIR=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y xvfb xauth lsof
      - name: Install frozen workspace and pinned Electron
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
          node scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(require('electron/package.json').version, '44.10.1')"
          pnpm exec electron-rebuild --module-dir . --force --only better-sqlite3 --version 44.10.1
      - name: Build existing Desktop prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-controller build
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
      - name: Prepare pinned native account app-server and private package-manager cache
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          selected_inputs="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-codex-login-inputs-XXXXXX")"

          pnpm --dir "$selected_inputs/corepack" add --ignore-scripts --save-exact corepack@0.36.0
          curl --fail --location --retry 2 --output "$selected_inputs/codex.tgz" https://registry.npmjs.org/@openai/codex/-/codex-0.162.0-linux-x64.tgz
          printf '%s  %s\n' dbd342e7ad896d53dbb505e926f1b82314b79a9d33e209b0b7616ced6b06c983 "$selected_inputs/codex.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$selected_inputs/codex.tgz" -C "$selected_inputs"
          COREPACK_HOME="$selected_inputs/cache" node "$selected_inputs/corepack/node_modules/corepack/dist/pnpm.js" --version
          CODEX_LOGIN_INPUTS="$selected_inputs" node --input-type=module <<'NODE'

          import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
          import { appendFileSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { join } from 'node:path';
          const sha = path => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');

  # Required by branch protection. Keep the name static for every event: on
  # PR #985 an edited-event run that reported another name left the required
  # context "Expected" although earlier runs for the same head had passed.
  # A title/body edit run skips the heavy jobs and its gate waits for the
  # same-input CI run instead of repeating it; it passes only on that run's
  # authenticated complete success. See docs/ci-qualification.md.
  full-qualification:
    name: Full qualification
    needs: [plan, validate, test, lint, task-change-ledger-windows, focused, source, dmg-artwork, retained-opencode-coexistence, codex-login-desktop]
    if: always() && !cancelled()

        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Require selected Codex login and native schedule qualification
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.metadata == 'false' &&
          github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false &&
          github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
          (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'feat/provider-host-frontend-parity-20261112' ||
           github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'feat/provider-host-frontend-parity-20261112')
        env:
          CODEX_LOGIN_RESULT: ${{ needs.codex-login-desktop.result }}
        run: test "$CODEX_LOGIN_RESULT" = success
      - name: Require selected retained V1 and Host V2 native Desktop qualification
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.full == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.reuse == 'false' &&
          ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.stage1_desktop) ||
          (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
          (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'feat/provider-migration-stage-1' || (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'feat/provider-migration-stage-1'))))
        env:
          RETAINED_COEXISTENCE_RESULT: ${{ needs.retained-opencode-coexistence.result }}
        run: test "$RETAINED_COEXISTENCE_RESULT" = success
      # The script deadline (METADATA_GATE.waitMs, 90 min) fails the gate first;
      # this timeout bounds the last proof after it. Either outcome is a failure.
      - name: Verify completed current-code qualification after metadata edits
        if: needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.metadata == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.full == 'false' && needs.plan.outputs.reuse == 'false'
        timeout-minutes: 100
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts metadata-gate
      - name: Require complete current-code qualification
        if: needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.full != 'false' || needs.plan.outputs.reuse != 'false'
        env:
          JOB_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          MODE_FULL: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.full }}
          MODE_REUSE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.reuse }}
          SOURCE_RUN: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.source_run }}
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts gate

name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: ['24.21.0', '26.11.1']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node24 Corepack source
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Setup selected Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Select pinned pnpm through selected Node
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          selectedNode="$(node -p 'process.execPath')"
          corepackJs="$RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE/node/24.21.0/$(node -p 'process.arch')/lib/node_modules/corepack/dist/corepack.js"
          test -f "$corepackJs"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/bin" "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/corepack"
          printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s" "%s" pnpm@11.18.0 "$@"\n' "$selectedNode" "$corepackJs" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/bin/pnpm"
          chmod 755 "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/bin/pnpm"
          printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          printf 'COREPACK_HOME=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/corepack" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          COREPACK_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchain/corepack" "$selectedNode" "$corepackJs" pnpm@11.18.0 --version
      - name: Install exact dependency graph
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Types, controlled tests and packed consumers
        env:
          # Retain the SAME exact bytes installed by the package-consumer test.
          AGENT_TEAMS_PROVIDER_PACK_TEST_RETAIN_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/checked-v2-spi
        run: pnpm check
      - name: Record exact-head checked archives (not a Host qualification)
        if: matrix.node == '24.21.0'
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
          import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
          import { readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
          import { join } from 'node:path'
          const root = join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'checked-v2-spi')
          const names = readdirSync(root).filter(name => name.endsWith('.tgz')).sort()
          if (names.length !== 2 ||
              names.filter(name => name.startsWith('agent-teams-provider-implementations-')).length !== 1 ||
              names.filter(name => name.startsWith('agent-teams-provider-session-contracts-')).length !== 1)
            throw Error('expected_exact_two_consumer_checked_archives')
          const head = execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim()
          if (head !== process.env.EXPECTED_HEAD) throw Error('unexpected_checkout_head')
          const packages = names.map(name => {
            const data = readFileSync(join(root, name))
            return { file: name, bytes: data.length,
              sha256: createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex') }
          })
          const receipt = { schemaVersion: 1, sourceCommit: head, packages,
            qualification: 'source-and-packed-consumer-only',
            nativeHostQualified: false, packagedElectronQualified: false }
          writeFileSync(join(root, 'receipt.json'), JSON.stringify(receipt, null, 2) + String.fromCharCode(10))
          console.log(JSON.stringify(receipt))
          NODE
      - name: Upload TEST-only exact-HEAD checked provider and Session SPI archives
        if: matrix.node == '24.21.0'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-spi-consumer-checked-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/checked-v2-spi/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

          HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/native-next-prompt-home" npm ls \

      - name: Verify actual App Server native turn and ephemeral fork (no vendor subscription)
        shell: bash

          NATIVE_SUGGESTIONS_CODEX_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/native-next-prompt-codex

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/native-prompt-suggestions-codex.mjs
          node scripts/native-prompt-suggestions-codex.mjs

name: OpenCode V2 native E2E qualification (TEST only)

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      # The pinned dependency graph and shared Session SPI define the
      # effective native driver contract just as much as its V2 codec does.
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/package.json'
      - 'packages/provider-session-contracts/package.json'
      - 'packages/provider-session-contracts/src/**'
      # Source changes to the private V2 wire, decoder or projection must
      # invalidate the native contract proof, not only harness edits.
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/src/features/provider-session-implementation/adapters/opencode-protocol/v2-*.ts'
      # The V2 driver also runs through this shared Session SPI engine and
      # bounded I/O. Changes here must invalidate native V2 receipts as well.
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/src/features/provider-session-implementation/adapters/opencode-protocol/driver-session.ts'
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/src/features/provider-session-implementation/adapters/opencode-protocol/driver-protocol.ts'
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/src/features/provider-session-implementation/adapters/opencode-protocol/input-window-capture.ts'
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/src/features/provider-session-implementation/adapters/provider-session-io/io.ts'
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/src/features/provider-session-implementation/adapters/provider-session-io/attachments.ts'
      - 'packages/provider-implementations/tests/features/provider-session-implementation/opencode-protocol/v2-*.ts'
      - scripts/native-v2-readonly-proof.mjs
      - scripts/native-v2-model-candidate.mjs
      - scripts/verify-native-v2-cli-hold.mjs
      - scripts/native-v2-embedded-proof.mjs
      - scripts/native-v2-spi-proof.mjs
      - scripts/verify-native-v2-embedded-floor-hold.mjs
      - scripts/verify-native-v2-interrupt-proof.mjs
      - scripts/native-v2-mcp-proof.mjs
      - scripts/native-v2-mcp-proof.test.mjs
      - scripts/verify-native-v2-receipt-safety.mjs
      - scripts/verify-native-v2-receipt-safety.test.mjs
      - .github/workflows/native-v2-readonly.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: native-v2-discovery-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  native-v2-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Actual 2.1.4 Session SPI over owned TEST HTTP server + persistent events.
          # Product Host/graph/process and packaged Desktop remain separate gates.
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-target-spi }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-target-spi }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-target-spi }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-target-spi }
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-target-spi }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: lifecycle }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: model }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-model }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-interrupt }
          # Exact pinned 2.0.21 private-Driver MCP TEST on all five native OS tuples.
          # No production Host process custody or 2.1.4 Driver admission implied.
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-mcp }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-target-mcp }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-floor }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-target }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-target-model }
          # TEST-only exact SDK 2.1.4 active stream cancellation and cold no-replay.
          # Separate from pinned 2.0.21: neither is a production Driver admission.
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-target-interrupt }
          # Discovery only: actual local fake-model tool call, policy hard-deny,
          # and an outside-workspace canary. Not a Host/production PASS.
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-target-tool }
          # Actual 2.0.21 private-driver pin: native tool blocked by explicit
          # session external_directory deny, not the newer config policy.
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, proof: embedded-pinned-tool }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-model }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-interrupt }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-target-interrupt }
          # Native SDK 2.1.4 offline model terminal, durable pagination and cold no-replay.
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-target-model }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-pinned-tool }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-target-tool }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-target-mcp }
          - { os: macos-15, proof: embedded-mcp }
          # GitHub-hosted macos-15 is Apple Silicon; macos-15-intel is x64.
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-model }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-interrupt }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-target-interrupt }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-target-model }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-pinned-tool }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-target-tool }
          # 2.1.4 MCP custody/readback on Intel macOS as well as Apple Silicon.
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-target-mcp }
          - { os: macos-15-intel, proof: embedded-mcp }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-model }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-interrupt }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-target-interrupt }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-pinned-tool }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-target-tool }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-target-mcp }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-mcp }
          # Windows 11 ARM64 is a separate native SDK tuple, not Server 2022 x64.
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-target-mcp }
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-mcp }
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-target-interrupt }
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-target-model }
          # Independently prove 2.1.4 tool.use/external_directory hard-deny on
          # Windows ARM64; MCP/interrupt evidence alone cannot qualify policy.
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-target-tool }
          # Private Driver still pins 2.0.21: independently exercise its native
          # interrupted-stream/cold-restart and built-in read deny/allow on ARM64.
          # TEST-only evidence; no platform/default/production qualification.
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-interrupt }
          - { os: windows-11-arm, proof: embedded-pinned-tool }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-target }
          - { os: windows-2022, proof: embedded-target-model }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Build exact workspace provider for native Session SPI
        if: matrix.proof == 'embedded-target-spi'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@11.18.0 -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
          npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@11.18.0 -- pnpm build
      - name: Validate native TEST harness syntax
        run: |
          node --check scripts/native-v2-readonly-proof.mjs
          node --check scripts/native-v2-model-candidate.mjs
          node --check scripts/verify-native-v2-cli-hold.mjs
          node --check scripts/native-v2-embedded-proof.mjs
          node --check scripts/native-v2-spi-proof.mjs
          node --check scripts/verify-native-v2-embedded-floor-hold.mjs
          node --check scripts/verify-native-v2-interrupt-proof.mjs
          node --check scripts/native-v2-mcp-proof.mjs
          node --test scripts/native-v2-mcp-proof.test.mjs
          node --check scripts/verify-native-v2-receipt-safety.mjs
          node --test scripts/verify-native-v2-receipt-safety.test.mjs
      - name: Install exact official V2 CLI into isolated test prefix
        if: matrix.proof == 'lifecycle' || matrix.proof == 'model'
        shell: bash
        env:
          npm_config_audit: 'false'
          npm_config_fund: 'false'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-native/npm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-native/install-home"
          HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-native/install-home" npm install \
            --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-native/npm" \
            --no-save --package-lock=true --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund @opencode/cli@2.0.21
          npm ls --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-native/npm" --depth=0 @opencode/cli
      - name: Install exact pinned embedded V2 SDK without install scripts
        if: startsWith(matrix.proof, 'embedded')
        shell: bash
        env:
          npm_config_audit: 'false'
          npm_config_fund: 'false'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-embedded"
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-embedded" --no-save \
            --package-lock=true --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund @opencode/sdk@${{ startsWith(matrix.proof, 'embedded-floor') && '2.0.0' || startsWith(matrix.proof, 'embedded-target') && '2.1.4' || '2.0.21' }}
          npm ls --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-embedded" --depth=0 @opencode/sdk
      - name: TEST native binary, authenticated API and disposable session lifecycle
        if: matrix.proof == 'lifecycle'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_NPM_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-native/npm/node_modules/@opencode
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/native-v2-readonly-proof.json
        run: node scripts/native-v2-readonly-proof.mjs
      - name: Assert stock CLI native model terminal HOLD (expected negative control)
        if: matrix.proof == 'model'
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_NPM_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-native/npm/node_modules/@opencode
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_MODEL_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/native-v2-model-candidate.json
        run: |
          set +e
          node scripts/native-v2-model-candidate.mjs
          status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$status" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Stock CLI changed behavior or did not execute; review native evidence before qualification"
            exit 1
          fi
          node scripts/verify-native-v2-cli-hold.mjs
      - name: Assert published SDK 2.0.0 Node ESM HOLD (expected negative control)
        if: matrix.proof == 'embedded-floor'
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_NPM_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-embedded
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/native-v2-embedded-floor-proof.json
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_VERSION: '2.0.0'
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MODEL_PROOF: '0'
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_EXPECTED_PLATFORM: 'linux-x64'
        run: |
          set +e
          node scripts/native-v2-embedded-proof.mjs
          status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$status" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Published floor SDK behavior changed; requalify before any adoption"
            exit 1
          fi
          node scripts/verify-native-v2-embedded-floor-hold.mjs
      - name: TEST embedded V2 persistent event log through cold host restart
        if: startsWith(matrix.proof, 'embedded') && matrix.proof != 'embedded-floor' && matrix.proof != 'embedded-interrupt' && matrix.proof != 'embedded-target-interrupt' && matrix.proof != 'embedded-mcp' && matrix.proof != 'embedded-target-mcp' && matrix.proof != 'embedded-target-spi'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_NPM_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-embedded
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/native-v2-${{ matrix.proof }}-proof.json
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MODEL_PROOF: ${{ (endsWith(matrix.proof, '-model') || endsWith(matrix.proof, '-tool') || endsWith(matrix.proof, '-interrupt')) && '1' || '0' }}
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_INTERRUPT_PROOF: ${{ endsWith(matrix.proof, '-interrupt') && '1' || '0' }}
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_TOOL_PROOF: ${{ endsWith(matrix.proof, '-tool') && '1' || '0' }}
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_VERSION: ${{ startsWith(matrix.proof, 'embedded-target') && '2.1.4' || '2.0.21' }}
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_EXPECTED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-15' && 'darwin-arm64' || matrix.os == 'macos-15-intel' && 'darwin-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-2022' && 'win32-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-11-arm' && 'win32-arm64' || 'linux-x64' }}
        run: node scripts/native-v2-embedded-proof.mjs
      - name: TEST embedded versioned active-interrupt HTTP cancel and cold no-replay
        if: matrix.proof == 'embedded-interrupt' || matrix.proof == 'embedded-target-interrupt'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_NPM_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-embedded
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/native-v2-${{ matrix.proof }}-proof.json
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MODEL_PROOF: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_INTERRUPT_PROOF: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_VERSION: ${{ matrix.proof == 'embedded-target-interrupt' && '2.1.4' || '2.0.21' }}
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_EXPECTED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-15' && 'darwin-arm64' || matrix.os == 'macos-15-intel' && 'darwin-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-2022' && 'win32-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-11-arm' && 'win32-arm64' || 'linux-x64' }}
        run: |
          node scripts/native-v2-embedded-proof.mjs
          node scripts/verify-native-v2-interrupt-proof.mjs
      - name: TEST embedded V2 local MCP stdio handshake and owned teardown
        if: matrix.proof == 'embedded-mcp' || matrix.proof == 'embedded-target-mcp'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_NPM_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-embedded
          OPENCODE_V2_MCP_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/native-v2-${{ matrix.proof }}-proof.json
          OPENCODE_V2_MCP_VERSION: ${{ matrix.proof == 'embedded-target-mcp' && '2.1.4' || '2.0.21' }}
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_EXPECTED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-15' && 'darwin-arm64' || matrix.os == 'macos-15-intel' && 'darwin-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-2022' && 'win32-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-11-arm' && 'win32-arm64' || 'linux-x64' }}
        run: node scripts/native-v2-mcp-proof.mjs
      - name: TEST native 2.1.4 Session SPI model, MCP permission, interrupt and cold restore
        if: matrix.proof == 'embedded-target-spi'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_NPM_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-embedded
          OPENCODE_V2_SPI_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/native-v2-embedded-target-spi-proof.json
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_EXPECTED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-15' && 'darwin-arm64' || matrix.os == 'macos-15-intel' && 'darwin-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-2022' && 'win32-x64' || matrix.os == 'windows-11-arm' && 'win32-arm64' || 'linux-x64' }}
        run: node scripts/native-v2-spi-proof.mjs
      - name: Refuse unsafe native TEST receipts before artifact publication
        id: receipt_safety
        if: always()
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EXPECTED_TEST_PROOF: ${{ matrix.proof }}
        run: node scripts/verify-native-v2-receipt-safety.mjs
      - name: Upload actual runner receipt (including safe failed checks)
        if: always() && steps.receipt_safety.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-discovery-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.proof }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
          path: |
            native-v2-readonly-proof.json
            native-v2-model-candidate.json
            native-v2-embedded-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-model-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-interrupt-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-target-interrupt-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-target-spi-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-mcp-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-target-mcp-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-floor-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-target-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-target-model-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-target-tool-proof.json
            native-v2-embedded-pinned-tool-proof.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-embedded/package-lock.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-native/npm/package-lock.json
